title: BOXES DRY ICE PELLETS/RICE
agency: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF.NATIONAL INSTITUTES OF HEALTH.NATIONAL INSTITUTES OF HEALTH OLAO
description_text: The National Institutes of Health (NIH), National Eye Institutes (NEI), Neurobiology, Neurodegeneration & Repair Laboratory (N-NRL), has a requirement to obtain weekly dry Ice deliveries for its ongoing research needs. This service must be performed with quick turnaround as the next phase of our research is dependent upon it.
